agent.finish_summary: Fixed regression in sqlparse/tokens.py: _TokenType.__getattr__ now raises AttributeError for dunder attribute names instead of synthesizing a new _TokenType object for them. This resolves the 'TypeError: _TokenType object is not callable' seen when copy.deepcopy/copy.copy (or other dunder-attribute-probing code) queried magic methods like __deepcopy__ on Token instances. Verified fix via the check tool (1 passing, 0 failing) and manual testing of copy.deepcopy/copy.copy on Token objects and parsed SQL statements.
